sub.text: One day Hoptron 5000
Robot world's most awesome and...
...damn sexy robot...
Was thinking about how awesome it is to be
a samurai, a ninja, a robot AND a bunny.
and enjoying a delicious burrito,
even though he doesn't have a mouth.
When suddenly, the evil Magic-Man jerk-face appeared and said:
"HAHAHHAHA Hoptron! I don't like you because... uhh... you know....
I'm jealous? Because you're too awesome!... or something...
It's not important!
What's important is
I'm going to steal your precious burrito,
and send you to evil giant food world,
where you'll die, like an IDIOT!
*Evil laughter*
Then Hoptron died like an idiot, and was never seen again.
The End.
What!? Ugh...
Well apparently, we gotta go to level 1.
and YOU decide if he dies... or not.
but he probably will die, like a lot, cause you probably suck.
